0.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_000
0.description: Time to see what aetheric conversion's done to me hammer─an' what that'll do to yer phantom weapon!

2.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_002
2.description: Success! If ye'd asked me but moments ago, I'd have sworn ye couldn't achieve aetheric harmony as perfect as this...

3.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_003
3.description: Behold the frightenin' power o' the void made manifest: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203>!

4.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_004
4.description: Behold the frightenin' power o' the void made manifest: <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E802020203> an' <hex:02310CFF054974656D03E803020203>!

5.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_005
5.description: See how that suits ye. 'Course, unless you put in the practice, even the finest arms'll feel like a lump o' scrap iron in yer hands.

6.name: TEXT_CTSMKDWEPTRADE3_00967_GEROLT_000_006
6.description: In other words, ye've got to use the bleedin' thing. Swing it about, fell some fiends─do what ye do best, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>!
